blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spanning 60.46 hours, CAST reduces normalized WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and subtitle edit rate from 254.2 to 221.9 min/hour against the WhisperX pipeline, and improves deletion rate by 11% on public datasets. We also present the behavior of each stage in the pipeline. CAST entered the production speech-to-text (STT) stage of our CC pipeline in late August 2026; we report the evaluation evidence and path to full-scale operation.
blocks.zh: 尽管在自动语音识别(ASR)方面迅速取得进展,但长式娱乐视频的字幕生成对于音乐和效果密集、口音丰富、交叉交谈和噪音等内容仍然具有挑战性。 笔录质量与声学模型一样,都取决于分区和周边模块. 单一的通过语音活动检测(VAD)可以错过昏暗的,低能的语音,同时转发在自动减码器中诱发幻觉和重复的近沉寂的片段. 这些相互竞争的错误促使VAD在语义和声学保留检查下重新审视被拒绝的部分。 将冷冻的Whisper大V3与分区、语言识别、歌词路由、以及目标明确的幻觉探测和修复合并在单一的NVIDIA L4 GPU上。 在超过60.46小时的100个内部资产上,CAST将正常WER从6.99%降至5.36%,对WhisperX管道的字幕编辑率从254.2分降至221.9分/小时,并将公共数据集的删除率提高11%。 我们还介绍了管道中每个阶段的行为。 CAST于2026年8月下旬进入我国CC输油管的生产语音对文本(STT)阶段;我们报告评价证据和全面运行的道路.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Our catalog spans feature films, episodic drama and comedy, unscripted reality,
news, children’s animation, live sports, and lifestyle programming, with
correspondingly diverse acoustics. Music, effects, and laughter are deliberately
mixed beneath dialogue, while naturalistic performance adds off-mic speech, rapid
interjections, overlapping turns, and singing that must still be captioned.
Captioning begins from a mixed program master rather than a close-talk
microphone. The ASR component transcribes audio and passes its
output to later stages, where its errors are unrecoverable. A word never emitted
can be assigned no speaker and placed in no caption block, while a phrase
hallucinated over silence propagates into a block a reviewer must locate and
delete. ASR quality bounds the entire CC pipeline.

Recent progress has come from large scale weak supervision and, more recently,
audio-language models. Whisper set the paradigm, training one encoder-decoder on
680,000 hours of weakly labeled multilingual audio for strong zero-shot transfer
without dataset-specific fine-tuning ( Radford et al. 2023 ) ; newer open-weight
families include Canary ( Puvvada et al. 2024 ) and Parakeet ( Xu et al. 2023 ) ,
alongside audio-LLMs such as Voxtral ( Liu et al. 2025 ) . On ITV entertainment
series, Cettolo et al. (2026) reported Whisper large-v3 better on unaggregated
segments, while Voxtral-Mini-3B benefits from longer aggregated segments and
achieves lowest WER. We adopt Whisper large-v3 for ASR as its permissive open weights let us serve the recognizer inside our own project boundary and control the serving configuration at catalog scale.

blocks.en:
As sequence-to-sequence models are trained on short utterances, input
segmentation governs long-form inference ( Gaido et al. 2021 ; Tsiamas et al. 2022 ) .
Whisper’s 30-second window forces it to traverse long audio in a sequential
decoding loop governed by thresholds on no speech probability, average
log-probability, and compression ratio ( Radford et al. 2023 ) ; when these
misfire, the model drifts, loops, or emits fluent text over silence and
music ( Koenecke et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2025 ) . The subtitling community has independently shown that such errors matter beyond WER, since subtitle quality depends jointly on text, timing, and line segmentation ( Wilken, Georgakopoulou, and Matusov 2022 ; Papi et al. 2023 ) . The widely adopted solution, VAD
segmentation with chunking and external forced alignment ( Lan et al. 2026 ; Bain et al. 2023 ) on full entertainment programmes, addresses both omitted speech and the errors that more permissive detection exposes.

blocks.en: Long-form media ASR gained broad attention with the Multi-Genre Broadcast (MGB) challenges, which extended earlier broadcast-news evaluations to 1,600 hours of multi-genre BBC television ( Bell et al. 2015 ) . WhisperX based ASR pipeline has been established as the most accurate in earlier work ( Lucca, Corso, and Pierri 2025 ; Bain et al. 2023 ) . Each of these failures has been studied on its own; segmentation via hybrid and iterative pause search ( Gaido et al. 2021 ) , the coupling of VAD errors to ASR insertions and deletions ( Lin et al. 2024 ) , hallucination suppression applied downstream of a decoder that has already seen non-speech ( Ahn et al. 2026 ) , and speech-in-music detection as a standalone benchmark ( Chaudhuri et al. 2018 ) , but not as a single system.

blocks.en:
In this work, we present CAST, the STT stage of our CC pipeline in production since late August 2026 on unscripted entertainment television. Deployed captioning systems are seldom described in the literature, published works benchmark recognizers ( Lucca, Corso, and Pierri 2025 ) or scores subtitle
quality ( Davitti et al. 2024 ) , but rarely opens the component that produces the transcript. To our knowledge, no prior work on a commercial STT component in entertainment captioning reports its routing decisions, its failures, and its measured effect on caption quality.

blocks.en:
We make three contributions. First , we show how to adapt a frozen, weakly supervised recognizer to this material without fine-tuning, a hierarchical segmenter re-examines apparent non-speech at progressively more permissive settings, terminal residuals face semantic and acoustic checks before admission, a cheap-to-expensive cascade escalates only ambiguous language decisions, lyric-bearing spans take a dedicated transcription route, and a text-side repetition check re-decodes only flagged spans. Second , we instrument every stage on a real catalogue, reporting which audio is admitted, how language and lyric decisions route it, and when repair fires; these are behavioural measurements, not annotated prevalence. Third , we report paired caption-quality evidence on 100 assets using WER, its component
errors, SubER, and editor time on a subset, together with the alternatives we abandoned and the path from production cutover to full-scale operation.

错误, SubER, 和一个子集的编辑时间, 加上我们放弃的替代品, 以及从生产切换到全面操作的路径。

blocks.en: Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST)
blocks.zh: 电视字幕ASR堆栈(CAST)

blocks.en:
Figure 1 (a) illustrates the CAST pipeline within the CC workflow. The pipeline processes the audio through source separation, segmentation, language
and lyric routing, transcription, repair, and final word alignment. In this section, we describe different stages of CAST and design choices.
blocks.zh:
图1(a)显示了CC工作流程中的CAST管道。 管道通过源分、分、语言处理音频
和词条的路由, 转录, 修复, 和最终的单词对齐。 在本节中,我们描述了CAST的不同阶段和设计选择.

blocks.en: Audio Source Separation
blocks.zh: 音频源分离

blocks.en: Entertainment assets arrive as mixed program masters in which instrumental music and sound effects are deliberately balanced against dialogue, and every downstream module of our pipeline inherits that interference. We first separate the mixture with Demucs ( Défossez et al. 2019 ) , retaining only the vocal stem, which preserves both spoken dialogue and singing, the content that we must caption, and we discard the music and effects stems. Every later stage of our pipeline operates on this vocal stem. We use separation for recognition alone: we never deliver the separated audio to viewers, so we optimize it for transcription rather than perceptual quality ( Syed et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 娱乐资产作为混合程序主机运来,其中乐器音乐和音效被刻意地与对话相平衡,我们管线的每一个下游模块都继承了这种干扰. 我们首先将混合物与德穆克(Défossez等,2019年)分开,只保留相声干,这既保留了口语对话,也保留了歌唱,内容我们必须有标题,我们抛弃了音乐和产生的效果. 我们输油管的每一个后期 都会用这个声干来操作 我们只使用分离来进行识别:我们从未将分离的音频传递给观众,因此我们优化了这些音频,以进行转录,而不是视觉质量(Syed等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Hierarchical VAD and Residual Admission
blocks.zh: 分级录用

blocks.en:
Whisper decodes audio in fixed 30 second windows, so long-form assets must be cut
into short segments, and how we cut them determines what the ASR model ever sees.
Missing a low-energy speech region leaves a missing caption block; passing a
silent window to the decoder as speech invites hallucination, which a single-pass VAD
cannot avoid.
blocks.zh:
Whisper在固定的30秒窗口中解码音频,所以必须剪去长式资产
切入短片,我们如何切出它们 来决定ASR模型所见过的东西。
缺少一个低能语音区域留下一个缺失的字幕块;通过一个
解码器的无声窗口作为语音邀请出幻觉,而幻觉是一个单通 VAD
无法避免。

blocks.en:
In the CAST pipeline, we propose a hierarchical VAD, which has multiple levels with increasing permissiveness. A speech region that the strictest level rejects is not discarded but re-examined at the next level, which typically recovers quiet or heavily masked dialogue; wherever a deeper level finds speech, that region rejoins the ordinary speech path and is treated like any other
utterance. A region that no level accepts becomes a terminal residual , which
we forward only when two independent checks agree, a semantic verdict that it
contains transcribable content, and an acoustic energy based filter. Difficult speech therefore gets several chances to reach transcription, while the residual path that produces
hallucinations stays tightly gated. Following we describe the stages of the hierarchical VAD.
blocks.zh:
在CAST管道中,我们提出一个分级的VAD,它具有多个层次,并且越来越宽容. 最严格级拒绝的言语区域不会被丢弃,而是在下一级进行再审,这通常会恢复静默或被严重遮掩的对话;无论哪个更深级发现言语,该区域都会重新加入普通的言语路径,并被像对待任何其他人一样对待.

blocks.en: Language Identification
blocks.zh: 语言识别

blocks.en: As we aim to caption English content only through the CAST pipeline, we add a language identification (LID) gate before decoding. As we use English language code in Whisper large-v3 inference, a foreign-language utterance may return plausible English tokens that become substitution errors.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的目标是仅通过 CAST 管道对英文内容进行字幕,我们在解码前会添加一个语言识别(LID)门. 由于我们在Whisper大V3推论中使用了英语语言代码,外语的发音可能会还回成为替代错误的可信英语符号.

blocks.en: In this stage, we decide which speech regions are English before passing to the transcription stage. Dropping accented English loses captions, while admitting foreign speech adds substitutions. We label each admitted span longer than 650 ms with a cheap-to-expensive cascade, because no single threshold serves both risks and escalation spends compute only on ambiguous spans. Whisper-base is the fast path when the English probability exceeds 0.8; we send the rest to the LID model MMS-LID-4017 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/facebook/mms-lid-4017 and accept its top label only at confidence 0.6 or above. Gemini 2.5 Pro handles low-confidence cases and MMS labels drawn from a curated set of 33 codes that are often returned for accented broadcast English, giving those spans a second decision rather than dropping them on the MMS label alone. We remove spans not labelled as English and we donot provide a separate multilingual transcription path.
blocks.zh: 在这个阶段,我们先决定哪个语音区域是英语,然后再转到转录阶段. 放弃重口音的英语会丢失字幕,同时承认外语会增加替换. 我们给每个被承认的人贴上超过650米的标签,上面有一个廉价至昂贵的级联,因为没有一个单一的阈值既能起到风险作用,又只计算出模棱两可的跨度。 Whisper-base是英语概率超过0.8时的快道;我们把其余部分发送到LID模型MMS-LID-4017 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/facebook/mms-lid-4017 并仅在0.6或以上置信度接受其顶级标签。 双子座 2.5 Pro 处理低信心案件和MMS标签,取自一套由33个代码组成的被曲解的代码,这些代码往往被退回重口音广播英语,使得这些代码跨出第二个决定期,而不是仅放在MMS标签上. 我们删除没有标为英文的字段,我们不提供单独的多语种文字记录路径。

segment-level language decisions (93.5%). MMS resolves another 106, while
530 spans (5.4%) reach Gemini. Gemini labels 302 of these spans as English
(57.0%), retaining them at the language gate; the other 228 receive a unknown label and are removed. In Figure 3 , we show the six largest named labels by duration, led by Spanish, and groups the remainder across 100 assets.

blocks.en: Lyric Classification and Routing

blocks.en:
Media files interleave songs and musical passages with dialogue, and general ASR
models handle them poorly. Sung and rapped lines carry narrative information
and must be captioned. So we add a classification stage that uses Gemini 2.5 Pro to
identify lyric-bearing segments. The classification is narrower than general music detection; singing, rapping, a cappella, jingles, themes, and short lyric-bearing phrases are
positive, while instrumental music, wordless humming, and ordinary speech over a
music bed are negative and a mixed span that is mostly speech stays on the
speech path. We merge consecutive positive spans. We route lyric-tagged segments to the lyrics-oriented transcriber, for which we again use Gemini 2.5 Pro. Figure 4 shows that most affected assets have only one tagged span (27 of 45), while six have four or more. Lyric aware transcription thus serves a small amount of audio spread across nearly half
the cohort.

表示含管线段。 分类范围比一般音乐探测范围要窄;歌唱,说唱,一首卡佩拉(cappella, jingles),主题,和短长有韵律的短语是:

blocks.en: Transcription
blocks.zh: 译名

blocks.en:
We decode every speech segment with Whisper large-v3 at temperature zero with the
language fixed to English. Where segments are close in time, we also pass the preceding
transcript as an initial prompt, which carries lexical context across boundaries. We decode lyric-tagged segments with Gemini 2.5 Pro, because the Whisper-large-v3 model under transcribes sung content. We prompt for audible spoken, sung, and rapped words only, including repetitions actually performed so that a chorus survives intact.
blocks.zh:
我们解码了每段语音 与Whisper大V3 在零温与
语言固定为英语。 如果时间很近,我们也会通过前一个
记录作为初始的快件,它具有跨越国界的词汇背景。 我们用双子座 2.5 Pro 解码了 Lyric 标记的片段, 因为Whisper - large-v3 模型在 translaps sung 内容下。 我们要求只讲、唱和说唱这些话, 包括重复,

blocks.en: In development we observe that Whisper omits words even when the segment contains the complete utterance. Therefore, we impose explicit protection by adding 50 ms of leading silence unless the segment already begins with silence or shows multiple language candidates. After decoding, we run a forced alignment, when the final word occupies an unusually large fraction of the segment (a signature of truncation) we redecode with additional trailing silence. We then pass the transcripts to repetition detection and repair stage.
blocks.zh: 在发展过程中,我们看到,即使片段包含完整的话语,Whisper也会省略词. 因此,我们通过增加50毫秒的主导沉默来实施明确的保护,除非该部分已经开始沉默或显示多种语言的候选者。 解码后,我们运行一个强制对齐,当最终单词占据了段段的异常大部分(一个截断的签名)时,我们重新编码,加上附加后继的沉默. 然后,我们通过记录 重复检测和修复阶段。

blocks.en: Repetition Detection and Repair
blocks.zh: 重复检测和维修

blocks.en: If the hierarchical VAD forwards some spurious silence, the decoder may loop or emit characters and enter hallucination stage. Deleting the silence would discard the words the front end recovers, so we re-decode locally before falling back.
blocks.zh: 如果分级的VAD转发出一些虚假的沉默,解码器可能会循环或放出字符并进入幻觉阶段. 删除沉默会丢掉前端恢复的词,所以在倒回之前我们在当地重新去掉代码.

blocks.en:
In the repetition detection stage, we search for two attributes, a phrase repeated in immediate succession, using n n -grams up to max_ngram =15, and a single character repeated five or more times. A phrase must recur at least min_repeats =6 times before we treat it as a candidate, which is high
enough to spare genuine speech a speaker who says “no no no” is not looping. For longer runs we require corroboration from at least one further condition, the phrase recurs eight or more times, the run begins after the first fifth of the transcript, it covers at least 70% of the words, or a six-repeat run begins after 60% of the transcript.
blocks.zh:
在重复检测阶段,我们搜索两个属性,一个短语在即时相继重复,使用n-gram到max_ngram=15,一个字符重复了5次或更多次. 一个短语必须至少重现 min_ repeats = 6 次之后,我们才把它当作一个候选人,这是很高的
一个说“不不”的发言者,如果说“不不不”的话,就不必再讲真话了。 更长的时间里,我们需要至少一个附加条件的证实, 短语重复了8次或8次以上, 运行开始于记录稿的前五分之一, 它覆盖至少70%的文字, 或者六重复运行开始于记录稿的60%。

blocks.en:
Once the detector flags a segment, we repair it from the original audio rather than by editing text, escalating only as far as we need to. We first re-decode the whole window under Whisper’s temperature fallback schedule (0.0-1.0), since resampling often escapes a loop that the main pass’s greedy decode could not. If the loop survives that decode, we search for a split point. We estimate the loop’s onset, quantise it to a one second grid and try that point first. Then
walk back from the segment end in one second steps, decoding each candidate and
accepting the first whose two halves are both clean. If only a trailing second
still loops, we keep the clean prefix; if no split succeeds, we retain the original transcript, so a failed repair never deletes words.
blocks.zh:
一旦探测器标出一段, 我们从原始音频中修复它, 而不是通过编辑文本, 我们首先在Whisper的温度回落时间表(0.0-1.0)下重新解码整个窗口,因为再生往往能从主通路的贪婪解码无法破解的回路中逃脱. 如果这个环能活下来 解码,我们寻找一个分点。 我们估计这个环的起发, 礛
隔一秒从片段端走回来 给每个候选人解码
接受第一个两个一半都是干净的。 如果只有次数
仍然循环,我们保留了干净的前缀;如果没有分拆成功,我们保留了原始的笔录,所以一个失败的修复永远不会删除字.

blocks.en: Experiments
blocks.zh: 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we describe our experimental setup, then the datasets on which we validate CAST, and finally the evaluation metrics through which we assess caption quality along complementary dimensions.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述我们的实验设置,然后是我们验证CAST的数据集,最后是评估尺度,通过这些尺度,我们按照互补的维度评估标题质量。

blocks.en: Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en:
To establish the impact of the multi-stage CAST cascade, we compare it against the
widely used WhisperX pipeline ( Bain et al. 2023 ) on both in-house and
publicly available data. We run GCP infrastructure in development and in
production. On a single NVIDIA L4 GPU, the full cascade occupies roughly
9 to 12 GB of VRAM and averages 27.4 minutes of compute per audio hour. Host RAM
is the binding constraint: programmes up to about 1.5 hours fit a 16 GB host,
while longer assets require 32 GB. Our main infrastructure risk is L4
availability under queued FLEX_START scheduling.

为了确定多阶段CAST级联的影响,我们将其与
广泛使用的WhisperX管道(Bain等人,2023年)既用于内部,也用于内部。
公开数据。 我们管理着GCP基础设施的发展和
生产。 在单一的NVIDIA L4 GPU上,整个级联大约占据着

是约束性限制: 最多1.5小时的节目适合16GB主机,
而更长的资产需要32GB. 我们的主要基础设施风险是L4
在排队的 FLEQSTART 调度中提供 。

We use two datasets. The first is an in-house corpus that we cannot release. To

caption cues. The cohort spans 48 known series across nine networks, covering
home renovation and property programmes, cooking competitions, factual
entertainment, automotive content, and paranormal series. Network and series
metadata are missing for 22 assets, which we nonetheless retain. Durations range
from 17.6 to 84.6 minutes, with a median of 42.3 minutes. Each asset has a manually
annotated WebVTT file, which we treat as its reference. Annotators mark blocks
containing lyrics or sung audio with musical notes; such blocks appear in 39
assets, across 457 cues.

blocks.en: Publicly available data

blocks.en:
To make our results reproducible outside our own catalogue, we evaluate CAST on
three public English long-form benchmarks. CORAAL ( Kendall and Farrington 2021 ) provides full-length sociolinguistic
interviews with speakers of African American Language, testing vernacular and
spontaneous speech. Earnings-22 ( Del Rio et al. 2022 ) is a 125-file,
119-hour corpus of earnings calls from companies in 27 countries grouped into
seven accent regions, and exercises accented multi-speaker audio.
Rev16 ( Radford et al. 2023 ) comprises the 16 podcast episodes retained from
Rev.ai’s 30-episode transcription benchmark, covering conversational studio
recordings with crosstalk. All three are long-form and spontaneous, but none
carries the music and effects beds of a programme master, so they test long-form
robustness rather than our hardest condition. Their references are verbatim
transcripts without cue or line structure, so we report WER alone on these
corpora.

blocks.en: Edit rate
blocks.zh: 编辑比例

blocks.en: We additionally measure edit rate , a human-effort metric obtained from a post-editing study with professional captioning vendors. Fifteen captioners edited CAST and WhisperX transcripts under blind review, we did not disclose which system produced a transcript, and we assigned the two versions of each asset to different captioners, so no editor saw both versions of the same content. We recorded the editing time of every session and report it as minutes of editing per hour of media.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: As described in the Dataset section, we evaluate CAST on in-house and public data. Our in-house references are caption files with cue and line structure, so we report WER, SubER, and edit rate. Whereas, the public references are verbatim transcripts, so we report WER alone.
blocks.zh: 如数据集一节所述,我们根据内部和公共数据评估CAST。 我们内部的参考文献是带有提示和行结构的字幕文件,所以我们报告WER,SubER和编辑速率. 而公开引用则是逐字记录,所以我们只报告WER。

blocks.en: Results on In-house Data
blocks.zh: 内部数据结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Evaluation of WhisperX and CAST on in-house data.

blocks.en:
We first evaluate the WER and SubER metrics on the in-house data for WhisperX and CAST pipelines, which are presented in Table 1 . We can observe from Table 1 that CAST reduces WER from 6.99% to 5.36% (23.31% relative reduction) and SubER from 14.72% to 11.18% (24.06% relative
reduction), when compared to WhisperX. It achieves lower WER on 95 assets and lower SubER on 97.

blocks.en: We further analysed insertion, deletion and substitution errors across CAST and baseline WhisperX. The deletions decrease from 16,402 to 10,859, resulting in a 33.79% relative reduction (28.79 to 19.06 per 1,000 reference words) as observed in Table 1 . Substitutions and insertions also decrease; therefore, the improved completeness is attributed to lower total lexical error. This pattern is consistent with the purpose of hierarchical VAD and residual admission, where we reconsider audio rejected as non-speech and give brief or faint utterances another opportunity to reach transcription. The counts establish fewer missing reference words at the system level; they do not establish how many contiguous passages were recovered or which stage recovered them. Isolating the VAD contribution requires an otherwise matched on/off ablation. The references are human production feedback captions rather than independently elicited verbatim transcripts. Their editing provenance and possible dependence on production hypotheses limit interpretation of the system difference.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析了整个CAST和基线WhiperX的插入、删除和替换错误。 如表1所示,删除数从16 402个减少到10 859个,相对减少33.79%(每1 000个参考字28.79个减少到19.06个)。 替代和插入也有所减少;因此,完整性得到提高的原因是词汇错误总数减少。 这种模式符合分级的VAD和剩余录入的目的,我们在此重新考虑以非口语方式拒绝的音频,并给予简短或微弱的言论另一种机会,以获得转录. 计数确定系统一级缺失的参考词较少;没有确定回收了多少个相接的通道,也没有确定回收到哪个阶段。 隔离 VAD 贡献需要用其他方式匹配。 参考文献是人类生产反馈说明,而不是独立取自的逐字记录稿。 他们的编辑出处和对生产假设的可能依赖限制了对系统差异的解释.

We run the editing study on 35 of the 100 in-house assets (19.9 programme hours). Table 2 reports edit rate and total edit time. Per-asset medians are 225.7 minutes per programme hour for CAST and 255.1 for WhisperX, with interquartile ranges of 206.3-235.9 and 236.6-276.3. roughly 3.7 hours per programme hour on CAST against 4.2 on WhisperX, close to an extra half hour of work for every hour of content under the incumbent transcription.

blocks.en: Results on Public Data
blocks.zh: 关于公共数据的结果

blocks.en: We evaluate CAST on CORAAL, Earnings-22 and Rev16, all of which comprise full-length recordings on which the hierarchical segmentation matters. In Table 3 , we report deletion, substitution and insertion errors and WER for both systems.
blocks.zh: 我们在CORAAL、EARINGS-22和Rev16上评价CAST,它们都包含完整长的录音,而分级则很重要。 在表3中,我们报告两种系统的删除、替换和插入错误和WER。

blocks.en:
From Table 3 , we can observe that deletions dominate the error budget on these corpora, running at 68.0 to 152.7 per 1,000 reference words for WhisperX, and CAST removes 11.1 to 11.8 of them.
The trade off differs from the result of in-house data, and demonstrate the significance of the CAST pipeline. More permissive detection buys deletions at the price of insertions, which rise by 3.3 to 6.8 per 1,000 words here but falls by 1.7 on the in-house data. The deletion reduction still exceeds the insertion increase on every corpus. However, in Table 3 the net WER gain is a modest 0.17 to 0.58 points against 1.63 on the in-house data. We note that deletions matter more than insertions for post-editing time in captioning, as editors must listen to the audio to recover missing words but can remove spurious ones on sight.
blocks.zh:
从表3可以看出,删除在这些蝎子身上的误差预算占主导地位,WhisperX的参考词为68.0至152.7分之1千分之1,CAST删除了其中11.1%至11.8%.
交易与内部数据不同,表明CAST管道的重要性。 更放任的检测以插入价格购买删除,此处每1 000个字增加3.3至6.8个字,但内部数据减少1.7个字。 删除的减少仍然超过每件文书的插入增加。 然而,在表3中,WER的净收益为0.17至0.58分,而内部数据为1.63分。 我们注意到,删除比在标题中插入编辑后的时间更重要,因为编辑者必须聆听音频以恢复缺失的文字,但可以在看到时删除虚假的文字。

blocks.en: Deployment and Lessons Learned
blocks.zh: 部署和经验教训

blocks.en: Integration and Serving
blocks.zh: 融合与服务

blocks.en: CAST entered production in late August 2026, replacing the previously deployed WhisperX pipeline. In the export step, CAST shapes WhisperX-aligned words into the same keys and nesting consumed from WhisperX, keeping the downstream interface fixed as traffic grows. This is schema-compatible by inspection, not byte-identical output and not a measured claim about integration cost. The STT stage is the first of several. A transcript reviewer edits CAST’s output, audio-transcript alignment re-times the reviewed words against the audio, speaker diarization assigns them to speakers, and the result is formatted into closed-caption blocks.
blocks.zh: CAST于2026年8月下旬进入生产,取代了之前部署的WhisperX管道. 在出口步骤中,CAST将WhisperX相通的单词塑造成从WhisperX所消耗的同键并筑巢,使下游界面随着流量的增长而固定. 这是通过检查、而不是字节相同产出和对整合成本的计量索赔来配合的。 STT舞台是几个舞台中的第一个. 一名笔录审查员编辑了 CAST 的输出,音频-transcript 校正将被审查的单词相对于音频重回时段,扬声器的分号指定给扬声器,结果被格式化为封闭封装块.

blocks.en: Operational Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 操作失败模式

blocks.en: In the repetition detection and repair stage of the CAST pipeline, we perform repeated decoding of the same audio. Across the 100 assets in-house data, 18 split searches evaluate 156 candidate splits, with a median of 7 and a maximum of 29. The maximum occurs on a segment of 95 s. Search cost therefore varies substantially even though repair is invoked for only 0.61% of input segments. We flag this as a limitation of the proposed approach.
blocks.zh: 在CAST输油管的重复检测和维修阶段,我们重复对同一种音频进行解码. 在100项内部资产数据中,18项分割搜索评价了156项候选人的分割,中间数为7项,最多29项。 因此,尽管只有0.61%的输入区段需要修复,但搜索费用差别很大。 我们认为这是对拟议办法的一种限制。

blocks.en: Lessons from Development
blocks.zh: 发展的经验教训

blocks.en: The VAD experiment is not the only redesign trigger. Across five repeated runs on two diagnostic assets, pyannote boundaries were stable but Gemini changed its keep/drop judgement on 1.6-2.6% of residuals. Tightening the prompt and adding Silero corroboration and trimming made merged segment counts identical across the five reruns. Mean WER improved on both assets, but n = 2 n=2 supports containment, not a general quality claim.
blocks.zh: VAD实验并不是唯一的重新设计触发器. 在两个诊断资产上,五轮反复运行,氰化物边界保持稳定,但双子座改变了对1.6-2.6%剩余物的保存/放弃判断。 紧紧地拉紧快线,并增加Silero的证实和修剪,使合并的段数在5个重跑中相同。 平均WER改进了两种资产,但n=2n=2支持封闭,而不是一般质量索赔。

blocks.en: Path to Full-Scale Deployment
blocks.zh: 全面部署的途径

blocks.en:
The remaining path to full scale has three gates, staged traffic increases with job-success, latency, and sampled D/I/S monitoring; a documented route back to WhisperX when those gates fail; and mitigation for GPU-queue exhaustion through capacity or regional fallback. Current telemetry contains only about 5 to 10 usable production observations, which is insufficient to estimate editor impact, fleet reliability, or unit economics. We therefore make no
production-outcome claim.

其余通向全规模的路径有3个出入口,随着工作成功,空档,并抽取了D/I/S监测;有记录的回Whisper路径 当这些闸门失效时的X;和通过能力或区域回落来缓解GPU-平流耗尽。 目前遥测只包含约5到10个可用的生产观测数据,不足以估计编辑器的撞击,机队可靠性,或单位经济学. 因此,我们拒绝
生产结果索赔。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose CAST, which processes only English content, and compares CAST with one incumbent rather than
external commercial systems. The 100-asset quality results are conditional
on the selection criteria stated under “Evaluation Data.” References
are human production-feedback captions; their editing provenance for this
cohort is not independently established. The earlier UAT references were
edited from CAST output and may favour that system. Neither cohort measures
editor time. Stage telemetry comes from a separate instrumented run on the
same 100 source assets, without frame-level speech, language, music, or
hallucination labels. The residual path and repair stage lack on/off ablations, so whole-system error reductions cannot be assigned to either module. Deletion counts also do not measure the number or duration of missing passages. Overlapping-speaker transcription is out of scope, and the recent production cutover leaves operational impact insufficiently measured.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present the STT component for captioning long-form unscripted television with a frozen recognizer, on the hypothesis that transcript quality also depends on the pipeline around the model. CAST puts that premise into practice, a recall first hierarchical segmenter reconsiders audio that a single VAD pass discards, semantic and acoustic gates decide which of that audio is worth decoding, and the language, lyric, and repetition stages handle the failure modes that more permissive detection exposes.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了STT组件,用于用被冷冻的识别器来给长式无标注的电视作字幕,其假设是:记录的质量也取决于模型周围的管道. CAST将这一前提付诸实践,一个首个等级分解器重新考虑一个VAD通过丢弃物,语义和声学门的音频决定了该音频中哪些值得解码,语言,语言,语言和重复阶段处理更宽容的检测暴露的故障模式.

blocks.en:
On 100 in-house assets, CAST reduces WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and SubER from
14.72% to 11.18% against WhisperX, cutting deletions by
33.79% with no aggregate rise in substitutions or insertions. The deletion
reduction reproduces on CORAAL, Earnings-22, and Rev16, though with smaller WER
gains and higher insertion counts against verbatim references. In a subjective study, the professional captioners spent 12.71% less time editing CAST transcripts.

blocks.en:
What we cannot yet claim matters as well. Our stage telemetry describes routing
rather than verified recovery, and without matched on/off ablations we cannot
attribute the deletion reduction to any single module. Those ablations, aligned
missing passage review, and editor outcomes measured across a monitored traffic
ramp are the evidence we still owe. For practitioners facing similar material, the transferable part is not our thresholds but the shape of the solution, leave the foundation model alone and spend the engineering effort on segmentation decisions, escalate from cheap to expensive models only on ambiguous input, and make failure asymmetric. So that uncertainty forfeits audio rather than inventing words. In captioning, a missing word costs an editor more than a spurious one, and a pipeline should be built to reflect that.

trailing silence.

CAST reduced LCNP deletions by 15.2 per 1,000 words while insertions rose by

eight titles. The exception, My Lottery Dream Home , contained heavy
crosstalk and accents and showed higher substitutions (46.3 versus 33.9 per
1,000) and WER (15.85% versus 12.89%). Edit tracking is computed by the
